Spotifast CJK fallback weight correction

Actual Linux X11 app captures with synthetic demo data. Baseline: Spotifast 0.14.1 (3ce8b3f), Fastframe v0.14.0. Candidate: Fastframe commit 71ce0cb, the same app and data, with variable fallbacks set to regular weight 400 rather than their Thin default. Text sizes, scale, baseline, primary Latin font and fallback order are unchanged.

Narrow: 900x760. Normal: 1400x900. The pointer is controlled at (2,2) for matched interaction states. The interactive candidate was also started on native Wayland. macOS and Windows were not tested.
